clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, an Encrypted Rune quietly calls promising new rogues to Anvilmar. Its message asks them to decipher its contents and seek out rogue trainer Solm Hargrin.

The Encrypted Rune is a discreet summons for those who show promise in stealth and cunning. Solm Hargrin, the rogue mentor in Anvilmar, sends the inscribed stone with ciphers for its bearer to decipher. The message tests whether a new rogue can read thieves' cant and introduces the shadowy craft needed to survive Dun Morogh's harsh wilderness.

Deciphering the rune leads new rogues to Solm Hargrin inside Anvilmar. He hopes to strengthen the valley's covert ranks amid rising local tensions. Along with bladecraft and stealth, Solm teaches vigilance and camaraderie. In a time of strained peace, rogues need to stick together.
